n: Ozark Trail Basic Quad Folding Camp Chair

cs.t: I am sitting in a $10 Walmart camping chair as I type this with my laptop in my lap. [edit: oops, it's $8  https://www.walmart.com/ip/Ozark-Trail-Basic-Quad-Folding-Ca... ] For me, the second part - the laptop in my lap - is 90% of working comfortably whether on the go or in my regular workspace. The chair just needs to be good enough...just needs to not have terrible ergonomics and for me "better" chairs tend to be worse. Chairs being better or worse based on theory won't reliably predict whether a chair is going to work for you. That's why Aeron's come in different sizes. Good luck. [PS: if a want shade, I put my chair in shade]
cs.th: Ask HN: Is there a good camping chair that is comfortable for programming?
